title: Logistics: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Logistics loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Create a simple storage area, label categories, and bind one useful loadout before expanding. A first-aid route kit is often more valuable than a huge unsorted warehouse.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: The first useful network is small: labeled storage, one route kit, one bound target, and a habit of asking what the network can actually supply.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Logistics is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
